_note: The tag vocabulary, and the only place new tags may be introduced. gen-contracts.mjs validates every `tags` array in meta.json against this file and fails the build on an unknown tag, so the vocabulary cannot drift into a free-text field. Keep it small: a tag that matches almost everything, or almost nothing, does not help anyone find anything. Each entry is the tag and what it promises to the reader who greps for it.

tags.forms: collects input from the user; posts in a form, or feeds one
tags.navigation: moves the user between views, or shows where they are
tags.layout: arranges other things; carries no content of its own
tags.data: displays a set of records — rows, entries, series
tags.feedback: tells the user what just happened or is happening
tags.overlay: paints outside its own box, over the rest of the page
tags.theming: changes how everything else looks: color, density, motion
tags.chrome: the frame around an app's content — bars, shells, page furniture
tags.status: encodes a state in color: ok, warn, danger, accent
tags.interactive: the user clicks, types or drags it
tags.stateful: holds state across interactions, not just at render
tags.async: fetches, polls or waits, and can be in flight
tags.keyboard: has keyboard affordances beyond plain tab-and-enter
tags.form-participating: takes part in a native form: name, value, validation, submit
tags.top-layer: escapes clipping ancestors via the browser's top layer
tags.light-dom: styles plain markup the app owns; not a custom element
tags.slotted: wraps markup the app still owns and keeps it in the light DOM
tags.surface: a background rung, or something that paints one
tags.density: trades padding for content at a given width
tags.brand: carries the app's identity: name, mark, accent
tags.a11y: exists primarily to serve assistive technology
